S  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  ABA No. 699 of 2023  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. R.S. Sammal, Advocate for the applicant.
2. Mr. Ranjan Ghildiyal, AGA for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. This is an application filed by the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with FIR No. 35 of 2022, under Sections 376, 417 IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at P.S. Kapkot, District Bageshwar.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
It is contended on behalf of the applicant that whatever relationship was there, it was consensual and both applicant and the complainant are major.

6. Learned State Counsel prays for and is granted three weeks' time for filing objection to the Anticipatory Bail Application.
7. List on 09.10.2023.
8.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, as an interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, applicant shall be released on interim anticipatory bail, on his executing personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he will make himself available at the time of interrogation by the Investigating agency, as & when required.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
